data.narrative:
Hadrian is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company with a current post-money valuation of $1.6B and $1.37B raised to date. The valuation assessment employs a peer universe of nine comparable companies, including eight private entities (Exotec, Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Agile Robots, Nimble Robotics, Divergent, and Locus Robotics) and one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods are applicable to this valuation. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C transitions, yielding an implied valuation of $2.7B. The Peer-Median method references six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Exotec at Series D valued at $2.0B; Generalist AI at Series B at $2.0B; Bedrock Robotics at Series B at $1.8B; Dexterity at Series B at $1.6B; and Agile Robots at Series C at $1.0B), producing a median valuation of $1.7B with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $1.4B (low) to $3.1B (high), with a median implied value of $2.2B. The current $1.6B valuation sits below this median, suggesting upside to Stage C progression multiples. Key uncertainties include stage advancement timing and the extent to which this company's operational metrics align with the broader peer cohort, given heterogeneity in stage distribution and valuation outcomes across the comparable set.
